hits.snippet: [Creality](https://www.voxelmatters.directory/company/creality/) took full advantage of its appearance at RAPID + TCT 2026 in Boston this week to present its broad hardware and software portfolio spanning 3D printing, 3D scanning, laser processing, filament recycling, and cloud-based management. Creality also presented the [Filament Maker M1 and Shredder R1, launched on Indiegogo earlier this month](https://www.voxelmatters.com/creality-launches-filament-maker-m1-shredder-r1/), and which it claims is the first integrated desktop system designed to recycle waste plastic and produce custom filament. It also scans black and reflective metal surfaces without requiring powder coating, and covers objects ranging from 5 mm³ to 4,000 mm³.
